patch_description: Fundamentally different approach: instead of soft-min gradient ascent, formulate the problem as an exact epigraph (minimax) nonlinear program — maximize t subject to t² ≤ ||xi−xj||² for all pairs and ||xi−xj||² ≤ 1 (diameter capped at 1) — and solve it with SLSQP from many structured inits (twisted heptagon bi-rings, staggered hexagonal rings with poles, icosahedron + axis pair, random). Since the ratio is scale-invariant, capping dmax at 1 makes t exactly the min/max ratio. Soft-min ascent on the sphere is used only as a cheap pre-conditioner to feed good starting points into the exact constrained solver, then the exact solution is polished with perturb-and-reoptimize rounds on the true nonsmooth objective. This directly maximizes the true ratio instead of a smoothed surrogate, which is where the previous gradient approach plateaued at 0.21.
